verdict.rationale: Munito AI is API-first. Its inference capabilities (chat, tool calls, vision, speech to text, document extraction, streaming, reasoning) are all exposed through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a published OpenAPI spec was confirmed live by probe. However, the console is described as where you manage keys and usage, and nothing shows those management functions are available through the API, so full UI-to-API parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for key management and usage/billing, an explicit statement of UI–API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
